errors.evidence: The bar for Spanien (Spain) represents a value of approximately 2.8%. Describing this as 'knapp über 2%' (just over 2%) is an inaccurate understatement, as the value is much closer to 3%.

errors.text_span: die Balken für Deutschland, Dänemark, Polen, Frankreich, Italien und Spanien im Bereich von unter 5-10% liegen
errors.evidence: This statement inaccurately groups several countries. The values for Polen (~3.8%), Frankreich (~3.3%), Italien (~3.1%), and Spanien (~2.8%) are all below 5%, while the values for Deutschland (~6.8%) and Dänemark (~6.5%) are above 5%. Placing them all in a single range of 'unter 5-10%' (from under 5 to 10%) misrepresents the data for four of the six countries mentioned.
The description groups most of the countries to summarize their values but completely omits mentioning 'Vereinigtes Königreich' (United Kingdom), which has a value of approximately 8.8%.
